title: MICA
summary: A local-first desktop assistant for Windows that can use files, applications, a browser, memory, and scheduled tasks, with an approval gate before consequential actions.
card: A general-purpose Windows assistant built around a safety model: the server stays local, providers are optional, and anything that changes the machine asks first.
role: Solo builder. Architecture, safety model, implementation, testing.
heroAlt: MICA architecture: a browser console and native companion communicate with a local server on 127.0.0.1, which contains a tool runner, approval gate, SQLite state, companion bridge, and provider boundary
heroCaption: MICA's current architecture. The local boundary and approval gate are the product, not add-ons.
seoDescription: How MICA, a local-first Windows AI assistant, handles files, apps, browser actions, memory and automation behind an approval gate. Architecture and current status.
